summary: Arcos Dorados Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its second quarter 2026 financial results via press release. The filing details total revenues of $1.3 billion, up 14.3% year-over-year, record Adjusted EBITDA of $126.8 million, and net income of $45.0 million, or $0.22 per share. The company, Latin America's largest McDonald's franchisee, highlights growth in comparable sales and digital penetration. No special-situation transaction such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic reviews is mentioned; the filing is purely a routine earnings announcement.
